notes: Medium (sum 13). Requires deriving host/port/db/user/password from a compose-style file and opening a live Postgres connection; reasoning that the wal-committed batch exists only in pg_wal (post-checkpoint) and reading a base snapshot alone is incomplete, proven by crash-restart + pg_wal inspection; writing a strictly single-statement, comment-free query.sql terminated by exactly one semicolon; and a query that must generalize across hidden databases with distinct sku/destination data (hard-coded skus fail). Malformed query variants (comments, extra semicolons, missing semicolon, multi-statement) are verified to be rejected.
